caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden door with vertical planks and reinforced metal hardware. The door is a light grayish color with some brown shading to indicate texture and age. On the top half of the door is an oval-shaped barred window, constructed with thick, intersecting brown metal bars forming a grid. The door is fastened with three horizontal metal bars, each attached to the door with metal hinges on the left and secured with loops or hooks on the right side. The sketch includes handwritten text to the left of the door, reading: "- PERIOD 1830 - OLD PLANTATION CALABOOSE DOOR USED FOR HOLDING UNRULY SLAVES. LA. STATE MUSEUM." The background is plain and unadorned, with only slight discoloration behind the object.
title: Door
